qi: A qi is the circulating life energy that in Chinese philosophy is thought to be inherent in all things.
Qi means the same as chi or ch'i or ki.
qiang: Qiang is the Tibeto-Burman language spoken in Sichuan.
Qiang means the same as Qiangic.
qiangic: Qiangic is the Tibeto-Burman language spoken in Sichuan.
Qiangic means the same as Qiang.
qibla: Qibla is the direction of the Kaaba toward which Muslims turn for their daily prayers.
Qibla can also mean a small terrorist group of Muslims in South Africa formed in the 1980s.
qin: Qin is the Chinese dynasty that established the first centralized imperial government and built much of the Great Wall.
Qin means the same as Qin dynasty or Ch'in or Ch'in dynasty.
qin dynasty: Qin dynasty is the Chinese dynasty that established the first centralized imperial government and built much of the Great Wall.
Qin dynasty means the same as Qin or Ch'in or Ch'in dynasty.
qin shi huang ti: the word Qin Shi Huang Ti
Qin Shi Huang Ti is the first Qin emperor who unified China, built much of the Great Wall, standardized weights and measures, and created a common currency and legal system.
Qin Shi Huang Ti means the same as Ch'in Shih Huang Ti.
qindarka: Qindarka is 100 qindarka equal 1 lek in Albania.
Qindarka means the same as qintar.
qing: Qing is the last imperial dynasty of China which was overthrown by revolutionaries.
Qing means the same as Qing dynasty or Ch'ing or Ch'ing dynasty.
qing dynasty: Qing dynasty is the last imperial dynasty of China which was overthrown by revolutionaries.
Qing dynasty means the same as Qing or Ch'ing or Ch'ing dynasty.
qintar: Qintar is 100 qindarka equal 1 lek in Albania.
Qintar means the same as qindarka.
qizil qum: Qizil Qum is a desert in Uzbekistan to the southeast of the Aral Sea.
Qizil Qum means the same as Kyzyl Kum or Kizil Kum.
